applyTo: "resources/**/*"

# FiveM Resources

Before editing, inspect the manifest, dependencies, owner domain, events, exports, callbacks, NUI callbacks, database contracts, and all callers/consumers. After changing a contract, audit consumers and preserve compatibility unless a coordinated migration is requested. Avoid circular dependencies and use guarded optional integrations where appropriate. Follow the inspect, validate, runtime-restart, new-console, and revalidate workflow in `AGENTS.md`.
